concepts.why: Biblical-theological and secular readers: Job 5:23 is Eliphaz speaking, and God says in Job 42:7 that Eliphaz has not spoken rightly of Him. Set among God's own words (Gen 9:13, Jer 33:20, 33:25, Hos 2:18) it reads as divine speech. Four passages remain, all spoken by the LORD.

Secular scholar: Acts 7:8 says 'the covenant of circumcision' but does not say 'sign', so it does not say what the name says. It is better under 'The covenant with Abraham' (7 passages there, room for one more), where it fits as Stephen's retelling.

Secular scholar: Exod 19:4 holds no covenant; it is the recital before 'if you will ... keep My covenant' in 19:5, which is already under 'Keep My covenant' and 'My treasured possession'. Six passages remain that do say covenant or the people's answer (24:3).

Secular scholar and Jewish reader of the Hebrew: the name is 'covenant of peace' (Num 25:12; Ezek 34:25; 37:26; Mal 2:5 'life and peace'). Neh 13:29 ('covenant of the priesthood') and Mal 2:8 ('covenant of Levi') do not say peace; Neh 13:29 is already in section C under Priesthood, and Mal 2:8 duplicates concept 18. Five passages remain.

Reformed, Lutheran, Catholic and Jewish readers: only Mal 3:1 says 'messenger of the covenant'. Mal 2:7 (the priest as messenger of the LORD of Hosts) and 2:8 (covenant of Levi) set beside it make the grouping suggest who the Messenger is, which traditions read differently (Christ, the priest, an angel, Elijah). Recommend removing this as a core concept, since the texts name the messenger of the covenant once, and listing Mal 3:1 alone as a secondary 'Covenant -> Messenger' line (Mal 3:1 only), which makes no identification. If the owner keeps it, it cannot meet the three-passage minimum honestly.

concepts.name: Covenants between people
concepts.why: Name against passages: 'The two of them made a covenant' is 1 Sam 23:18 only; 2 Sam 5:3 is the king and the elders, Josh 9:15 is Joshua, the leaders and the Gibeonites, and Mal 2:14 and Amos 1:9 are about a marriage covenant and a broken covenant of brotherhood. A plain label fits all eight. Josh 9:15 note left as the BSB reads (Hebrew berit checked).

Name against passages, and Jewish/Christian readers: Isa 42:6 does not say foreigners hold fast to the covenant; it appoints 'you' (whom traditions identify differently: Israel, the Servant, the Messiah) 'to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations'. Including it under this name takes a side on who the 'you' is. Gen 17:12, Deut 29:11-12, Isa 56:6 and 56:7 (can be one passage, 56:6-7) remain.

secondary_or_links: Add secondary 'Covenant -> Messenger' with Malachi 3:1 only, if concept 18 is removed (see concept 18). Otherwise sections C and the ten links are accepted as they are.
